title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray works towards the goal that women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing and meaningful participation and leadership. This objective supports women and older adolescent girls to use GBV specialised interventions and psychosocial support. Activities include the provision of psychosocial and other supports to GBV survivors; referrals to supports as needed; capacity building for women and WCOs. The principal focus of this objective is: - Women’s protection and access to specialised GBV supports - Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys - Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
